title: Best AI Assistant Connectors for Tailoring Your Résumé to Each Job (2026)
summary: Claude, ChatGPT, Meta Muse, Grok Bot and OpenClaw can all tailor a résumé. Tsenta compares the connectors and skills that do it per job in 2026.
body_markdown:
**The best Claude connectors for tailoring your résumé to each job are Tsenta’s MCP server and JobGPT’s MCP server, which you add yourself as custom connectors, because we found no résumé connector in Claude’s directory.** Tsenta tailors a résumé for each role it applies to and, with résumé review on, shows every change as a diff before anything is sent, while the free Resume Tailor & Job Match plugin and the Google Docs connector cover a résumé you send yourself.


Among the other assistants, ChatGPT is the only one with built-in résumé tailoring. OpenClaw has community skills for it, Grok Bot has user-shared Bot templates, and Meta Muse and Instinct describe neither a résumé feature nor a résumé connector. Tsenta publishes step-by-step setup for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Codex at[tsenta.com/mcp](https://tsenta.com/mcp) , and other assistants that support custom remote MCP servers over Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in can use the same server address.


Checked November 20, 2026. Tsenta publishes this guide and sells one of the services in it. We read each assistant maker’s docs and each connector’s, skill’s, template’s or GPT’s own page that day, but we did not install every skill or run every template. We rank by how close each option gets you to a résumé tailored for one job that you can check before it goes out, then by setup and cost. Prices are as of November 20, 2026.


## Three ways an assistant tailors a résumé


- **Ask it directly.** Paste your résumé and the job post, ask for a tailored version and copy the result out.
- **Add saved instructions.** A skill, Bot template or custom GPT makes the rewrite repeatable, with a match score, a keyword list and rules against invented facts.
- **Connect a service.** A connector, plugin or MCP server calls a service that stores your résumé, tailors it per job and, for some, submits the application.


Whichever route you take, check every title, date, number and skill before you send it.


## How Tsenta’s MCP server tailors your résumé for each role


Tsenta’s MCP server connects your own AI assistant to your Tsenta account. Your assistant gets roles ranked against your profile from the 300,000+ company career pages Tsenta watches and starts applications that Tsenta submits in the cloud on supported company career sites. For each one, Tsenta tailors your résumé for that role and drafts a cover letter when the form takes one. You set how much it rewrites under **Settings** , **Apply settings** , **Resume optimization** : **Off** sends your résumé as written, **Honest** rewords your existing experience for the role, and **Aggressive** rewrites more freely and may stretch claims, so review every claim.


**The diff.** Turn off résumé auto-approval and each tailored résumé waits under **Needs you** in the Tsenta dashboard, with every change highlighted in green. Hover a change to see your original wording and a **Revert** button, and a **What I changed** summary lists the edits. As[Tsenta’s pricing page](https://tsenta.com/pricing) puts it, you see each change as a diff and approve or edit it before anything goes out. Edit the text, or ask for changes in the chat beside it, then choose **Approve & submit** or **Use original resume** . Say “from now on” in that chat and Tsenta keeps the rule for future résumés made from a PDF résumé profile.


The diff lives in the dashboard, not the chat. From your assistant, ask it to show you each tailored résumé before it approves, or to have Tsenta redo one with your instructions, such as “lead with my SaaS experience”, a limited number of times per application. Your assistant approves through Tsenta’s tools, and whether it asks you first depends on the assistant, not on Tsenta. One approval gives it every available Tsenta tool on your account, including actions that change account data, so connect only assistants you trust.


Auto Apply, which submits eligible roles within your filters without per-role approval, needs Power and skips manual review. On Starter and Pro you choose each role and Tsenta submits it. Résumé optimization and cover letters come with every plan. Your first 25 applications are free, once, with no card, and only submitted applications count. In USD global pricing, Starter is $19 a month for 600 applications, Pro $39 for 1,500 and Power $99 for 4,500 per 30-day cycle. See[pricing](https://tsenta.com/pricing) for other billing periods and local prices.


Where others win: Tsenta tailors as part of an application, so it is not a standalone résumé editor. For a tailored file you send yourself, ChatGPT’s built-in tool, a skill or Workopia fits better. Tsenta is not listed in Claude’s or ChatGPT’s directories, so you add` https://api.autojobs.me/api/v1/mcp` yourself. The[help article](https://help.tsenta.com/connect-claude-chatgpt-mcp) covers privacy and disconnecting.


## 1. Claude connectors and plugins


**What Claude does on its own.** Claude rewrites a résumé you paste or upload.[Anthropic’s Google Workspace guide](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/10166901-use-google-workspace-connectors) adds that the Drive connector reads Docs, PDFs and Office files as text, and a separate Google Docs connector lets Claude edit a Doc live in a pane beside the chat, on the web in Chrome and in Claude Desktop with its built-in browser on. Keep a master résumé in Drive and have Claude edit a copy for one posting with you.


**The best Claude connector or plugin for tailoring.**[Claude’s directory](https://claude.com/marketplace/connectors-plugins) lists about 1,200 connectors, and we found none with “resume”, “résumé” or “career” in its name or one-line description. Its job connectors, Indeed, Dice, ZipRecruiter and Snagajob, search listings and send you elsewhere to apply. So you add one yourself:


- **Tsenta** tailors per role as it applies, with the diff review above.
- **JobGPT.**[6figr’s MCP server](https://github.com/6figr-com/jobgpt-mcp-server) connects at` https://mcp.6figr.com/mcp` with browser sign-in. Its` generate_resume_for_job` tool tailors your résumé for one job with your own asks, keywords and sections, with an optional PDF, and` calculate_match_score` scores the fit. Résumé generation uses credits, and[6figr](https://6figr.com/auto-apply) lists 5 free applications, then $34.99 a month for 100 auto applies.
- **Resume Tailor & Job Match.** A free, instructions-only plugin from[SvyatoSllav’s repository](https://github.com/SvyatoSllav/claude-plugins) , listed on[MCP Market](https://mcpmarket.com/tools/skills/resume-tailor-job-match) . It gives a 0 to 100 match score with each requirement marked strong, weak or missing, pulls 10 to 15 keywords from the posting, rewrites your bullets and leaves a placeholder where a number is missing. It is MIT licensed, dates from September 29, 2026 and has no GitHub stars yet. In Claude Code, install it with` /plugin marketplace add SvyatoSllav/claude-plugins` , then` /plugin install resume-tailor-job-match@plugins-factory` . MCP Market also offers it as a skill download. The output is plain text.
- **Simplify.**[Simplify’s MCP server](https://help.simplify.jobs/articles/8107058-use-simplify-in-claude-chatgpt-and-codex-mcp) , published November 20, 2026, makes a tailored copy of a saved résumé, keeps the original and lists what it changed. It needs Simplify+,[$39.99 a month or $19.99 a week](https://help.simplify.jobs/articles/5623502-whats-included-in-simplify-features-and-pricing) , and Claude does not show its tailored PDF in the chat yet.


**Tsenta as a Claude connector.** Under **Customize** , **Connectors** , choose **Add** , then **Add custom connector** , name it Tsenta, paste the server address and select **Continue** . If asked about authentication, choose **Sign in now** and **Register automatically** , select **Add** , then **Connect** , and sign in to Tsenta.[Tsenta’s setup page](https://tsenta.com/mcp) has every step, including the menu some accounts show instead.[Anthropic’s guide](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11175166-get-started-with-custom-connectors-using-remote-mcp) lists custom connectors on Claude’s Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team and Enterprise plans, with one on Free. In Claude Code, run` claude mcp add --transport http tsenta https://api.autojobs.me/api/v1/mcp` , then` /mcp` . Claude also[lets you set each tool’s permission](https://claude.com/docs/connectors/getting-started) , so set Tsenta’s` approve-application` and` set-apply-preferences` tools to **Always ask** if you see that option, or keep the chat in **Manual** mode, and Claude asks you before it approves a tailored résumé or turns résumé auto-approval on.[In Auto mode](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13345190-get-started-with-claude-cowork) , a tool set only to **Needs approval** can run without asking. More on[Tsenta’s Claude connector page](https://tsenta.com/connectors/claude) and in[the best Claude connectors for job search](https://tsenta.com/blog/best-claude-connectors-job-search-2026) .


## 2. ChatGPT apps, plugins and GPTs


**What ChatGPT does on its own.** OpenAI’s[June 1, 2026 release note](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-release-notes) says you can upload or create a résumé, tailor it to a specific role and download it formatted, in English on the web on every plan. For one-off tailoring with no setup, start here.


**The best ChatGPT app or GPT for tailoring.** OpenAI now[calls add-ons plugins](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001256-plugins-in-chatgpt) , which bundle apps and skills.


- **Workopia.** Its[directory listing](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_69d48d1113e88191954bf235f0a87a89) says you open a job and click **Tailor** , a live widget highlights missing skills, and you export an ATS-friendly PDF and a cover letter. You apply on the employer’s posting yourself. Other directory plugins also tailor a résumé to one posting, including[CVEmber](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6adc973f91608191968c2a426093a98c) , which saves each tailored résumé as a new version and says it never invents employers, titles, degrees, dates or numbers, and[Rezi](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a8d2d18e7c8819195ab593d685d7eed) .
- **Upplai.** Its[listing](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_69619c97f3288191ad90f579d3fd6352) scores your résumé against a job description from 0 to 100 with a keyword analysis, and[Upplai](https://www.uppl.ai/ats-checker-chatgpt) offers 20 free scores with an account. Use it to check a draft.
- **Custom MCP servers.** Tsenta, JobGPT, Simplify and LoopCV, which[says it adjusts your CV](https://www.loopcv.pro/apply-with-chatgpt/) for each posting, connect as custom servers. Simplify says ChatGPT shows its tailored PDF in the chat.


Custom GPTs are on their way out.[OpenAI](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001519-custom-gpt-retirement-and-migration-faq) retires them on December 11, 2026, later only for FedRAMP workspaces and Enterprise workspaces with an approved deferral, and[personal accounts](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/8554407-gpts-in-chatgpt) can no longer create or publish new ones.[FeaturedGPTs’ résumé list](https://featuredgpts.com/categories/resume-writing/) ranks Jobright’s Resume GPT first by ratings, and Resume.co’s[Resume GPT](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-iPOQIlHpk) says it can tailor your résumé to any job. You sign in to ChatGPT to chat with either one. See our[custom GPTs for job search guide](https://tsenta.com/blog/best-custom-gpts-job-search-2026) .


**Tsenta as a ChatGPT app.** On ChatGPT for the web, open **Plugins** , select **+** , then **Add custom MCP server** , enter Tsenta’s server address with **OAuth** and create it as a plugin.[Tsenta’s setup page](https://tsenta.com/mcp) has every step.[OpenAI’s help center](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/12584461-connecting-custom-mcp-servers-in-chatgpt) lists full MCP support, which applying needs, on ChatGPT Business, Enterprise and Edu on the web. ChatGPT Pro can connect custom servers with read and fetch only. On a plan with full MCP support, Tsenta tailors your résumé for each role the same way, and with résumé auto-approval off you check the diff under **Needs you** in your Tsenta dashboard before it is sent. Our[ChatGPT apps for job search ranking](https://tsenta.com/blog/best-chatgpt-apps-job-search-2026) compares the wider field.


## 3. Meta Muse connectors


This is Meta’s personal AI agent, not The Muse job board.


**What Muse does on its own.** Meta[launched Muse](https://about.fb.com/news/2026/09/introducing-muse-personal-ai-agent/) on September 8, 2026, and it now runs in the US, Canada, Singapore and[Australia](https://about.fb.com/news/2026/11/muse-is-now-available-in-australia/) . It is[free with a weekly usage limit](https://www.meta.com/help/subscriptions/1021145227643680/) , with Meta’s Power plan at $20 a month and its Maximum plan at $100. Meta’s help center says Muse can[read, summarize, edit or generate artifacts](https://www.meta.com/help/superintelligence/1331373868832401/) such as PDFs and documents. No Meta page mentions résumés, cover letters or job applications.


**The best Muse connector for tailoring.** Meta names none. Its public lists include[Gmail](https://about.fb.com/news/2026/11/muse-is-now-available-in-australia/) ,[Outlook](https://www.meta.com/help/superintelligence/1149305437517250/) , and[Notion, Box, Dropbox and Canva](https://muse.ai/business) , but nothing for résumés or job search, and Google Drive is not named. One routine is to keep your master résumé in Notion or Dropbox, ask Muse for a tailored PDF for one posting and read every line.[Meta’s connectors help](https://www.meta.com/help/superintelligence/1687253048996149/) also says you can ask Muse to create a custom connector for a service not in its list, which can involve retrieving API information, and that Meta does not review custom connectors.


**Tsenta and Muse.** Not as a documented setup yet. Meta’s public Muse pages do not describe adding a remote MCP server by its address. If your Muse account supports custom remote MCP servers, give it Tsenta’s server address and sign in with OAuth. If it connects, the same per-role tailoring and diff review in your Tsenta dashboard apply. Because Muse is an agent that can browse and act on websites, in its own browser or through[its Chrome extension, which can use sites you are already signed in to](https://www.meta.com/help/superintelligence/2124746764949121/) , it can open tsenta.com and work in your Tsenta account in its browser, the way you would. That is ordinary browsing, not a Muse connector or integration. See[applying to jobs with Meta Muse](https://tsenta.com/blog/meta-muse-apply-to-jobs-2026) and[Meta Muse vs Grok Bot vs Instinct](https://tsenta.com/blog/meta-muse-vs-grok-bot-vs-instinct-job-search) .


## 4. Grok Bot plugins and Bot templates


**What Grok Bot does on its own.** Grok Bot works from a cloud computer with a browser, command line and files, and[its docs](https://docs.x.ai/grok-bot/computer-and-apps) list apps such as Gmail, Drive and Docs. It comes with Premium at $30 a month and higher tiers of[The X Subscription](https://docs.x.ai/x-subscription/pricing) , not with Plus. Its docs never mention résumés or job applications.


**The best Grok Bot plugin or template for tailoring.** The maker’s[marketplace](https://x.ai/bot/marketplace) lists Bots, and “plugin” is its word for an app or MCP server you connect. We found no job-seeker Bot in the marketplace and no résumé plugin in its app catalog. The useful picks are user-shared Bot templates on x.ai, each labelled “created by a third-party user, not by SpaceXSI”:


- **[Resume Optimizer: Tailor Resume to Job](https://x.ai/bot/rEba1S2MuOrKRmLRbEflv)** , shared by GrokBotGod. Paste your résumé and one job post and get it reworded in that post’s words, plus a list of gaps, as text, Word or PDF. Its listing says it never adds jobs, skills, dates or numbers. The independent[grokbot.dev](https://grokbot.dev/marketplace/resume-optimizer-tailor-resume-to-job/) directory also lists it.
- **[Job Application Assistant](https://x.ai/bot/3cymtsAFCEoIB3gpHAv4a)** , shared by Ray, tailors a résumé, cover note and fit note to each posting as PDFs and says it never applies without your yes for that role.


Read a template’s instructions before you import it. As a plugin,[Himalayas’ MCP server](https://himalayas.app/docs/apply-to-jobs-using-grok-bot) publishes a Grok Bot guide, and its[MCP docs](https://himalayas.app/docs/remote-jobs-mcp) list a tool that generates tailored application documents. A free account includes one AI résumé,[Plus at $9 a month and Max at $29](https://himalayas.app/pricing) add unlimited AI tools, and it covers remote roles on Himalayas only.


**Tsenta as a Grok Bot plugin.** Possibly. Grok Bot’s docs say that in the Grok Bot desktop app you can open **Connect apps** , choose **Add a custom connector** , pick **Remote HTTPS** with a server address and save it with **Add plugin** , or ask Grok Bot to add an MCP server by its address. Use Tsenta’s server address and sign in to Tsenta if asked. Tsenta has no Grok Bot guide yet, and a connected app is available to every Bot on your account. If it connects, the same per-role tailoring and diff review in your Tsenta dashboard apply. See[the best Grok Bot plugins for job search](https://tsenta.com/blog/best-grok-bot-plugins-job-search-2026) .


## 5. Instinct connectors


**What Instinct does on its own.** Instinct, from Spear Street Technology, is a personal assistant[you text or call](https://instinct.com/) , and its[terms](https://instinct.com/terms) say it is currently free. Its[privacy policy](https://instinct.com/privacy-policy) says linking Google Workspace gives it your calendar and email inbox, that its browser can act on sites you have not connected, and that it keeps files you send. No Instinct page mentions jobs or résumés.


**The best Instinct connector for tailoring.** None exists to pick. Google Workspace is the only linked service its public pages name, and they describe no custom connectors. You can send it a résumé and a job post and ask for a draft, but check every line.


**Tsenta and Instinct.** Not as a documented setup yet. Instinct’s public site does not describe custom connectors or MCP servers. If your Instinct account supports custom remote MCP servers, add Tsenta’s server address and sign in with OAuth. If it connects, the same per-role tailoring and diff review in your Tsenta dashboard apply. More in[Instinct AI connectors for job search](https://tsenta.com/blog/instinct-ai-connectors-job-search-2026) .


## 6. OpenClaw skills


**What OpenClaw does on its own.** OpenClaw is a[free, MIT-licensed](https://docs.openclaw.ai/) assistant you run on your own computer or server and reach from chat apps. It has no paid tier, and you pay for the model you connect.[Skills](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/skills) are` SKILL.md` instruction files on the open ClawHub registry, and[OpenClaw’s FAQ](https://docs.openclaw.ai/help/faq/security-and-access-control) says to treat third-party skills as code you choose to trust.


**The best OpenClaw skills for tailoring.**


Skill Where What it does Counters, Nov 20, 2026


**[Resume Assistant](https://clawhub.ai/wscats/skills/resume-assistant)** ClawHub,` @wscats/resume-assistant` Polishes, tailors to a job description with a gap table, scores out of 100 and exports; adds metrics where a bullet has none 22,027 downloads, 794 installs


**[Resume / CV Builder](https://clawhub.ai/sebastian-buitrag0/skills/resume-cv-builder)** ClawHub,` @sebastian-buitrag0/resume-cv-builder` Tailors to a pasted job description and exports Markdown, HTML, LaTeX or PDF; needs pandoc 5,628 downloads, 184 installs


**resume** ClawHub,` @ivangdavila/resume` Checks ATS compatibility and tailors to specific jobs 2,812 downloads, 78 installs


**Resume Tailor** ClawHub,` @suntianchong/resume-tailor` Résumé and cover letter matched to one job description 1,468 downloads, 30 installs


**[resume-tailor](https://github.com/lqminhhh/openclaw-resume-tailor)** GitHub and[skills.lc](https://skills.lc/lqminhhh/openclaw-resume-tailor/lqminhhh-openclaw-resume-tailor-skill-md) Saves one Word file, never overwrites your original, lists strengths, gaps and improvements, never invents experience Not on ClawHub; no stars, no license


Install a ClawHub skill with its owner in the name, such as` openclaw skills install @sebastian-buitrag0/resume-cv-builder` , because publishers reuse slugs. Downloads are registry counters, not users. resume-tailor is the strictest on facts, and you copy its folder into your skills path.


**Tsenta and OpenClaw.** Tsenta connects to OpenClaw as an MCP server rather than a skill.[OpenClaw’s docs](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/mcp/transports) describe saving a remote server with the streamable-http transport and OAuth, then signing in with` openclaw mcp login` . Use Tsenta’s server address there, and name the transport, because OpenClaw uses SSE when you leave it out. By default OpenClaw shares one sign-in across everyone who messages a Gateway. Tsenta has no step-by-step OpenClaw guide yet, so check the tools OpenClaw lists after you sign in. Once connected, the same per-role tailoring and diff review in your Tsenta dashboard apply. See[the best OpenClaw skills for job search](https://tsenta.com/blog/best-openclaw-skills-job-search-2026) .

To add Tsenta in Cursor, put the server address in` mcp.json` and sign in from **Customize** . In the Codex CLI, run` codex mcp add tsenta --url https://api.autojobs.me/api/v1/mcp` , then` codex mcp login tsenta` . Both get the same per-role tailoring and the same diff review in your Tsenta dashboard. ## Frequently asked questions


### What are the best Claude connectors for tailoring my résumé to each job?


The best Claude connectors for tailoring your résumé to each job are Tsenta’s and JobGPT’s MCP servers, added as custom connectors, because we found no résumé connector in Claude’s directory. Tsenta tailors a résumé for each role it applies to, in Honest or Aggressive mode, and JobGPT tailors one per job with a tool that uses JobGPT credits. For a free rewrite with no account, the Resume Tailor & Job Match plugin scores your fit from 0 to 100 and rewrites your bullets for the posting.


### What are the best ChatGPT apps for tailoring my résumé to each job?


Workopia is the best ChatGPT app we found for tailoring your résumé to each job, with a Tailor button on each job and an ATS-friendly PDF export. You may not need an app: since June 1, 2026 you can upload or create a résumé in ChatGPT, tailor it to a role and download it, in English on the web on every plan. Tsenta, JobGPT and Simplify tailor per job as custom MCP servers, and their write actions need full MCP support, which OpenAI lists on ChatGPT Business, Enterprise and Edu.


### What are the best custom GPTs for résumé tailoring in the ChatGPT store?


Jobright’s Resume GPT is the most-rated résumé GPT on FeaturedGPTs’ résumé list, and Resume.co’s résumé GPT says it tailors your résumé to any job. Both stop working when OpenAI retires custom GPTs on December 11, 2026, later for some workspaces, and ChatGPT Free, Go, Plus and Pro accounts can no longer create or publish new GPTs. For tailoring that lasts, use ChatGPT’s built-in résumé tool or a plugin.


### What are the best MCP servers for tailoring my résumé to each job?


Tsenta, JobGPT and Simplify are hosted MCP servers that tailor a résumé for each job and can also submit the application, while Himalayas and Hidden Jobs tailor documents for roles you apply to yourself. Tsenta tailors in Honest or Aggressive mode and, with résumé review on, shows each change as a diff before anything is sent. Local projects such as Resume MCP Server also tailor, but they are small and rarely updated.


### What are the best Muse connectors for tailoring my résumé to each job?


Meta names no Muse connector for résumés or job search, so there is no best one to install as of November 20, 2026. Meta says Muse can edit documents and generate PDFs, so you can give it your résumé and a job post and review what it drafts. Tsenta has no documented Meta Muse setup yet, because Meta’s public Muse pages do not describe adding a remote MCP server by its address.


### What are the best Grok Bot plugins for tailoring my résumé to each job?


We found no résumé plugin in Grok Bot’s marketplace or app catalog, so the practical picks are user-shared Bot templates such as Resume Optimizer: Tailor Resume to Job, each labelled as created by a third-party user. Himalayas’ MCP server, which publishes a Grok Bot guide, adds tailored résumés for remote roles. ### What are the best Instinct connectors for tailoring my résumé to each job?

Instinct’s public pages name Google Workspace as the service you link and describe no job, résumé or custom connectors, though Instinct accepts files you send it, so you can share a résumé and a job post and ask for a draft. ### What are the best OpenClaw skills for tailoring my résumé to each job?


Resume / CV Builder and resume-tailor are the OpenClaw skills to start with. Resume / CV Builder, with 5,628 ClawHub downloads on November 20, 2026, tailors a résumé to a pasted job description and exports it with pandoc, and the resume-tailor skill on GitHub saves one Word file and lists strengths, gaps and improvements, with a rule never to invent experience. Resume Assistant, the most-downloaded résumé skill we found on ClawHub, also tailors to a job description, but its prompt adds metrics where a bullet has none, so check every number. Tsenta connects to OpenClaw as an MCP server rather than a skill, and Tsenta has no OpenClaw guide yet.


### Can I see what Tsenta changed in my résumé before it is sent?


Yes, when résumé auto-approval is off. Each tailored résumé then waits under Needs you in your Tsenta dashboard, with every change highlighted, your original wording on hover and a What I changed summary, and you can edit it, ask for changes, approve it or send your original résumé instead. Auto Apply, which needs Power, skips this review.
